name: while-you-wait
description: While Claude works, the side panel lists what you can do meanwhile on GitHub: pull requests waiting for your review (with the diff and a quick pre-review), your own pull requests that need you, issues assigned to you.

nudgeAfterMinutes.title: While you wait: minutes before the hint
nudgeAfterMinutes.description: How long Claude works before the status line shows what you could do meanwhile

openPanel.title: While you wait: open the side panel by itself
openPanel.description: Open the panel when the hint shows, not only on /wait

onlyThisRepo.title: While you wait: this repository only
onlyThisRepo.description: List only the pull requests and issues of the repository Claude is working in
